title: The Double Asset
author: Jonah Okonkwo
blurb: Petra Fairweather, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
